usedFor: Pitchit scores your leads, and MailerLite mirrors them when “When a lead's priority changes” runs “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's priority changes” in Pitchit, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A lead whose priority shifts is added or refreshed in MailerLite, so your emails follow the sales view.

watchOut: A subscriber needs an email address, so check that Pitchit leads carry one before “Create or Update Subscriber” runs.
